posts.title: Seeking Sole mate.. to share football boots!
posts.description: Like 1 in 5 people, my feet are different size. Are yours? Right 1 size bigger? L: EUR 45 / US 11 / UK 10 | R: EUR 46 / US 12 / UK 11 If these are your sizes: congrats you’re my shoe twin! If you play football (soccer), I’d like to send you a free pair of Nike boots (cleats)! (See How for details) other sizes / sports Fill the form on ShoeFits.me and I’ll try to match you up with your ‘sole mate’

📵 Doh that Apple MacBook’s Voice Isolation actually removed the drum sticks! For future vlogs I’ll actually use the Tula mic.. which I rebought for recording new podcast I’m seeking tech critic guests for, as you’ll see in my latest Article
